# Sync Socials

> Sync Socials is social media planning, content creation, scheduling, and publishing software for creators, businesses, and agencies. Work in the dashboard or connect an AI agent through the hosted MCP/API.

Product facts updated September 17, 2026. Integration approval status was last confirmed September 11, 2026 and is still listed as pending:

- Live destinations: TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn personal profiles, Telegram, Discord, and Slack.
- Facebook Pages and linked Instagram professional accounts work for eligible existing connections. Meta has verified Sync Socials as a Tech Provider, but the permissions required for general new-customer access remain in App Review. Contact support before subscribing if Facebook or Instagram is essential.
- X/Twitter, Pinterest, and LinkedIn company pages are not currently supported.
- The ChatGPT directory integration was submitted on September 11, 2026 and is in review. It is not yet approved or publicly listed in ChatGPT.

Key facts:

- One dashboard for planning, scheduling and publishing to every connected platform
- Viral Machine turns a website or business brief into campaign concepts, hooks, captions, and hashtags. After a concept is chosen, it can produce vertical videos from library clips or remix uploaded brand footage. Drafts can be saved without choosing a destination.
- MCP and API access lets compatible AI agents read workspace and brand context, list connected accounts and media, import media, generate concepts, produce videos, create and edit drafts, schedule and publish selected posts, reschedule, cancel, and check delivery status.
- Video production can continue asynchronously; retrieve the post to check completion and obtain a fresh signed playback URL.
- Pricing: one Growth plan at $19.95 per month or $199.50 per year (2 months free), with a free 7 day trial and cancel anytime
- 20 accounts per platform and unlimited scheduled posts, no fees per post
- Posts publish through supported platforms' APIs. Reach and engagement depend on the platform, content, audience, and timing; results are not guaranteed.
- Social accounts use official OAuth where supported. Telegram uses a bot token; Discord and Slack use channel webhooks. Sync Socials does not ask for social-network passwords.
- Built and personally supported by founder Damiano Tobasco
- Partner Program pays 30% recurring commission on cleared net subscription revenue for as long as the referred customer remains subscribed
- Qualified referrals can unlock cumulative one-time cash bonuses up to $4,000 after generating at least $199.50 in cleared subscription revenue; annual customers also complete a 30-day refund window

## Install for AI agents

npx skills add DamianoTobasco/sync-socials-agent -g

Requires a Sync Socials account with API access and an API key generated from workspace settings. Store the key in the agent environment, never in public content.

Hosted MCP endpoint: https://app.sync-socials.com/api/mcp

Compatible clients must support the hosted MCP/API and its authentication. A skill provides instructions; the client's own connection and tool support still determine what it can do. Discovering or citing the public website in ChatGPT, Grok or another assistant is separate from connecting an account and operating its publishing tools.

Supported workflow: read workspace and brand context, choose or generate content, create drafts, select connected destinations, then schedule or publish when the user requests it. Generation may finish asynchronously; check status before using generated media. Platform privacy and disclosure choices apply when publishing.

## ChatGPT account linking

The submitted integration exposes 14 tools through OAuth. A workspace owner signs in to Sync Socials with their existing account and explicitly approves access to that workspace. Email sign-in authenticates the owner; the separate consent step authorizes ChatGPT. Access can be disconnected in Settings.

An existing account with API entitlement is required. Some generation features need a workspace-configured AI provider and consume that provider's allowance. Scheduling and publishing require selected destinations and applicable platform privacy/disclosure choices.

Directory approval, public availability, and conversational recommendations are decisions made by OpenAI. No placement or traffic is guaranteed.

## Claude hosted connector preview

The Claude connector is in limited testing. Its public directory listing and companion plugin are pending; self-service public connection is not available yet. Invited testers receive secure setup instructions from Sync Socials support. A server URL alone is insufficient for the current preview. Application secrets must not appear in public configuration or conversations.

The connection requires a Sync Socials workspace owner, API entitlement, and eligible billing status. It supports account and media browsing, text concepts, drafts, selected scheduling and publishing, and delivery checks. The Claude connection uses existing images and videos and does not generate images, footage, speech, or music through AI models. Text concept generation requires a configured workspace AI provider and uses its allowance.

This hosted OAuth preview is separate from direct Claude Code/API-key setup. Disconnecting Claude in Sync Socials Settings stops that authorization's access but leaves existing scheduled posts and other agent connections intact. Public directory sign-in instructions will be added after the listing and public authentication are available. Listing does not guarantee recommendations or placement.
